# 📱 App Store & Google Play ASO Kit: Gate Breaker: Morph Saga

## 1. Store Metadata

* **App Name (Max 30 chars):** `Gate Breaker: Morph Saga`

* **Keywords (100 chars):** `slingshot,gate,breaker,evolution,rpg,avatar,creator,castle,smash,saga,arcade,hypercasual`

### 🤖 Google Play Store
* **App Name (Max 30 chars):** `Gate Breaker: Morph Saga`
* **Short Description (Max 80 chars):** `Design any hero, beast, or vehicle—pull back, evolve, and shatter fortress gates!`
* **Full Description:**
```
Build your own warrior, beast, turbo vehicle, living warhammer, or cosmic orb in Gate Breaker: Morph Saga—powered by MorphForge Engine!

🔥 KEY FEATURES:
• Multi-Archetype Avatar Creator: Customize Humanoid, Animal, Vehicle, Artifact, or Abstract entities with hair/top styles, skin/paint colors, accents, and custom names.
• Hybrid Evolution System: Evolve from a humble Tier 1 rookie to a Tier 5 winged legend with branching specializations AND 5 modular equipment slots!
• Pull-and-Release Gate Siege: Aim down the fortress lane, smash patrolling guardians, ricochet off walls, and shatter unique material gates (Wood, Iron, Stone, Ice, Magma, Laser, Cosmic).
• Evolutionary Audio & Visuals: Every tier amplifies your rig's procedural vector armor, particle aura, and Web Audio impact synthesis.
• Portable DNA Codes: Export and share your character DNA across games!
```

* **Screenshot 2 (Core Loop):** "PULL, AIM & SHATTER!" (Slingshot trajectory dots blasting through goblins into a cracking stone gate).

## 3. Privacy Policy
* **Target Audience:** Everyone (PEGI 3 / ESRB Everyone)
* **Data Collected:** None (Zero personal data stored on external servers; character DNA and saga progress are stored locally on device).
